etymologies.etymologyHTML: From any +‎ how.

definitions.definition: (manner) In any way or manner whatever.
(conjunctive) In any case. Used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement.
Without care or tidiness; recklessly, negligently or randomly.

quote.text: It was a woman’s clothing, beyond a doubt, all thrown in anyhow, — as if the person who had placed it there had been in a desperate hurry.

definitions.definition: (Singapore, Singlish, predicative) Random, careless, offhand, disorderly; done without thought or consideration.

quote.citation: 2022 January 25, Jean Wong, Cassandra Nerva, Jerald Ang, “34 Singlish Phrases to Know Before Visiting Singapore”, in tripzilla.com‎[1], archived from the original on 30 September 2024:
quote.text: Rabak, to refer to something messed up: Eh bro, your hairdresser anyhow sia, your hair damn rabak.

quote.citation: 2024 December 13, gwbasic, “Is it all the food influencers cannot make it?”, in HardwareZone Forums:
quote.text: Even the newspaper recommendation oso anyhow one.
